newsitem.title: RUSSIA: EBRD grants $16.8 mln to Russian glass-maker.
newsitem.headline: EBRD grants $16.8 mln to Russian glass-maker.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) granted a $16.8 million loan to Russian glass-maker OOO Faboyta Anopino Plus, the bank said on Wednesday.
Spanish commercial banks will provide $9.8 million in co-financing, it said in a statement.
The loan will be used to buy new equipment and technology to produce high-quality bottles, it said.
The company is a joint venture in which Russian glass-maker AO Anopino holds 50 percent, with the remainder owned by Spain's Kabrain Dos Asociados s.l. and A.K. Robins Italia s.r.l.
It will sell its produce on the Russian and international markets.

Kabrain Dos Asociados s.l. is a member of the Kabedosa Group, a private Spanish food and packaging company. A.K. Robins Italia s.r.l. is a subsidiary of VHC Holding, a U.S. processing technology manufacturer, the EBRD said.

Russia's current production of glass bottles is about one billion bottles annually, but the potential market is expected to grow to 9-10 billion, while growth over the last three years has been at annual rate of 30 percent, EBRD said.
